title: V-JEPA-LM: Video-Language Models That Read Dynamics Beyond Static, Text-Aligned Representations
abstract: arXiv:2611.17831v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: World-model video encoders such as V-JEPA learn how scenes change (direction, speed, order, state) from video alone. To answer questions, they are joined to a language model trained on captions and question-answer pairs. But each caption or question names only a few attributes of a clip, so the model learns to retrieve those attributes rather than to read the clip, and the dynamics the encoder carries go unused: on the same items, a linear probe reads speed from frozen V-JEPA features at 87% while the VLM answers at chance. We show where dynamics lives in a frozen encoder: in a subspace shared across videos for predictive encoders such as V-JEPA, but not as a shared component of frame-wise, text-aligned encoders such as SigLIP. We then build counterfactual supervision that makes the language model read it: pixel transformations turn public videos into answer-balanced variants whose answers are set by the transformation and differ only

translated_title: V-JEPA-LM：能够读取静态文本对齐表征之外动态信息的视频-语言模型
translated_abstract: 诸如V-JEPA这样的世界模型视频编码器仅凭视频本身就能学习场景如何变化（方向、速度、顺序、状态）。为了回答问题，它们需要与在字幕和问答对上训练的语言模型相结合。但每条字幕或问题只描述片段的少数几个属性，因此模型学会的是检索这些属性而非真正读取片段内容，编码器所携带的动态信息也就未被利用：在相同的测试项上，线性探针可以从冻结的V-JEPA特征中以87%的准确率读取速度，而视觉语言模型（VLM）的回答仅处于随机水平。我们展示了动态信息在冻结编码器中的所在位置：对于V-JEPA这类预测性编码器，动态信息存在于一个跨视频共享的子空间中；而对于SigLIP这类逐帧、文本对齐的编码器，动态信息则不是其共享组成部分。随后我们构建了反事实监督，使语言模型能够读取这些动态信息：通过像素变换将公开视频转化为答案平衡的变体，其答案由该变换决定，且仅在（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出V-JEPA-LM，通过定位V-JEPA冻结特征中跨视频共享的动态子空间，并利用像素变换构建反事实监督，使视频语言模型能够真正读取编码器中蕴含的场景动态信息（如速度），而非仅仅检索文本对齐的静态属性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes V-JEPA-LM, which localizes the cross-video shared dynamics subspace within frozen V-JEPA features and employs counterfactual supervision via pixel transformations, enabling video-language models to genuinely read scene dynamics (e.g., speed) beyond static, text-aligned attributes.
